name: Jollof Rice with Chicken
steps: Blend the tomatoes, red bell pepper, half the onion, and chilli into a smooth base.
Fry the remaining sliced onion in the vegetable oil, then stir in the tomato paste and cook until it darkens.
Pour in the blended base and simmer until thickened and the raw smell has cooked off.
Add the chicken pieces and simmer until fully cooked through, with no pink remaining and juices running clear.
Stir in the rice, cover, and cook on low heat until the rice is tender and has absorbed the sauce.
